entities.name: Emil Müller
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emil Müller was a Swiss mycologist. He specialised in the study of the systematics of the ascomycetes, particularly grass-inhabiting species. Müller significantly contributed to mycological taxonomy and published more than 200 peer-reviewed scientific articles during his career.
